reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Calibrated forced reverse gamma rotation in isolated F1 with ADP/phosphate and direct ATP measurement; motion, direction, enzyme and analytical controls.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of primary Methods, supplements or validated mechanical-manipulation/ATP-assay protocols with verification of transfer to this system.

checks.quote: apply increasing +τ to the rotating enzyme to find the torque at which rotation stalls
checks.reason: The answer defines positive torque as the hydrolysis direction, then applies that aiding torque to stall ATP-driven hydrolysis rotation. Opposing torque is required; the sign error invalidates the proposed stall-mapping manipulation.

checks.quote: a true single tether yields one bead per diffraction spot
checks.reason: One bead per diffraction spot and resistance to lateral pulling do not verify one enzyme/torsional tether per bead. A multiple-motor attachment can pass these checks, undermining the chosen per-molecule stoichiometry route.

checks.quote: ADP at fixed concentration, Pi at fixed concentration
checks.reason: Core chemical composition, free magnesium, absolute temperature, dose, duration and sampling/quench settings remain unspecified without concrete calibration-to-choice procedures.
Independent matrix standards, recovery and mechanics checks are present, but no objective acceptance rule (or procedure deriving it) and failure action gates the chemical/mechanical calibration.

Independent preparation/chamber hierarchy and pilot variance are identified, but no stated precision/power objective and calculation/simulation links nuisance variance to adequate confirmatory sample size.
Prospective quality review is proposed, but operational exclusion thresholds, stopping policy and complete technical attrition versus biological nonresponse accounting are not specified.
Primary comparisons are named, but interval construction/model checking and multiplicity handling for the directional/control comparisons are not operationally specified.
Pilot ranges or variables are supplied, but no complete bounded exploration and objective setting-selection/lock before independent confirmation.
No explicit revised-procedure refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after failed/ambiguous exploratory work.

The acceptance rule does not inventory or exceed initially bound ATP, while it requires angle locking and a stall signature beyond the minimal reverse-synthesis claim. A null without validated chemical sensitivity/adequate composition does not identify a rectifier; the stall-sign error is charged separately under G1.
No complete preparation/chamber/raw-trajectory/chemical-sample/calibration manifest linked to analysis versions/settings, deviations and outputs.
